note: Requires SI_GITHUB_TOKEN (PAT) + exactly one of SI_GITHUB_REPO or SI_GITHUB_ORG. Token only used to mint a short-lived registration token via the GitHub API; briefly visible in process args (curl header, su -c), same exposure level as other secrets already passed through this project's modules. With systemd, installs as a service (svc.sh); without it, starts run.sh directly (falls back gracefully, but won't survive a reboot without systemd). One runner per host (fixed SI_GITHUB_RUNNER_DIR).
